transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Please avoid heavy work for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts, and sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful, and that may need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts, and sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal,

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you feel all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!
